messages:
maria: Heads-up — PR #19877 is queued to land before the Friday deploy-freeze but macOS CI is flaky and stuck on `unit-tests-macos`.

ajay: I saw the failure, looks like a timing-related test. Can you paste the failing log? @ci-bot can you re-run the job once I ack? :eyes:

maria: Here's the failing snippet:
```
FAIL tests/test_scheduler.py::TestScheduler::test_delayed_task
AssertionError: expected 2, got 3
Timeout: 30.02s
```

ci-bot: CI rerun scheduled: job `unit-tests-macos` for PR #19877 queued by @ajay. Status: queued -> running.

kevin: I can take a quick look at the test tomorrow morning (UTC). If it's flaky we should avoid forcing a rebase inside the freeze window.

maria: We have a rebase window tomorrow 14:00-15:00 UTC (small window to resolve conflicts). If CI still flakes we'll need either: a) a fast hotfix to the test, b) manual approval + canary if everyone signs off, or c) delay until after freeze.

ajay: If the rerun passes, can we get one reviewer approval? @kevin can you +1 after your quick sanity check? :pray:

kevin: Yep, will do if rerun is green and no new failures. If it flakes again I'll pair on the test fix with @maria.

maria: Also note — this PR touches runtime batching config. If we land without the macos job green it might trigger regressions. Prefer to wait for green.

ci-bot: Rerun complete: job `unit-tests-macos` PASSED for PR #19877 (run 2). Full status: all checks green.

ajay: Nice. @kevin can you review now? If you approve I can merge in the rebase window.

kevin: Quick skim done. Looks fine. Left one tiny comment but not blocking. Approving now. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — merging in the 14:00 UTC rebase slot. I'll watch rollout for 30m and escalate if any errors from dedicated infra.

ajay: I'll kick off a canary after merge and monitor metrics dashboard (latency, error-rate). If anything spikes we can revert quickly.

kevin: Great plan. If anyone is out during the slot pls ping on-call. :bell:

maria: tagging the oncall team — @ajay please post a short post-merge note in #eng-sre so they see the canary plan.

ajay: Will do.
